name: Surveillance Station
description: Watch your IP cameras from EthOS: MJPEG live grid, per-camera motion detection with event thumbnails, snapshots and MP4 recordings. The camera service stays in EthOS (ffmpeg, motion threads, path-scoped recordings) so recordings keep running headless; this package ships the desktop app.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.1: requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.0: first release. The Surveillance desktop app moves out of the core install; cameras, motion detection and recordings stay in EthOS, so recording continues even without this package.
